blocks.title: The diagram stays editable
blocks.text: Font size, node shapes, and node effects live in each Mermaid block’s appearance field. Change the controls or edit JSON to restyle a diagram without modifying its generated SVG.

blocks.title: Choose a shape with meaning
blocks.text: Try Soft shadow, Blue glow, and Coral glow on the Build node. The first diagram also uses glow on Choice and Share; the second shows the same flow without effects.
